endpoints.notes: Route-level auth is none: the old streamToken in the body is the credential. New token is signed with StreamSecrets[0], TTL 24h. Expired/wrong-signature/non-stream tokens → 401. M3 adds the dual-key rotation window: a token signed with the configured previous secret still refreshes while that secret is present; removing it rejects the old token. Rotation itself does not revoke an unexpired token — there is no observed revocation ledger (sid blacklist UNKNOWN).

endpoints.notes: M5 proxies Anthropic Messages to an explicitly configured upstream (--llm-upstream-url) with an explicitly configured credential (--llm-upstream-key) and auth header style (x-api-key or bearer). The M3 Bearer boundary is preserved: invalid/expired/wrong-signature → 401 {error:{type:hive_stream_token_invalid}}. With a valid credential the body is streamed verbatim (unknown fields preserved); anthropic-version/anthropic-beta are forwarded; the client's Authorization and x-api-key are stripped and replaced with the upstream credential. Upstream 4xx/5xx (including 429) are relayed verbatim. text/event-stream responses are relayed line-by-line with a flush per line, so every upstream event reaches the client immediately. No upstream configured → 400 llm_upstream_not_configured (never 200). Model routing, billing and rate limits remain UNKNOWN and are not implemented; the model field is passed through unchanged.
